[spoiler=Meeting the Ostlandians and a northern suprice][b][u]The joining of Nordiheim and Ostland and a rather baffling suprice.[/u][/b]

In the decently sized castle of Hadanger, a port city in the barony of Gyldenhorn that was the west moust part of Ostland, Knut of Smør satt down at his desk in what had become his his "base of opperation" as the leading noble of the now expanded "Norse Empire of Nordiheim" and sighed.
This sigh was both of relife that the last negotiations and signing of papers was finished between them and the Golden Kingdom of Ostland, but also of disappointment and utter disbelief.
When they had made contact with the golden nobles about two months ago the plan of the council didn't joust work it worked so well that it was almoust hard to keep up the act, he actualy had to help 'Lord' Gaute at one point as the man had found it difficult to keep up the act when they had achived what was basicly mind numingly unrealistic results in no time at all, thankfully the man had been able to get his act together befour someting bad could happen.

These golden nobles dident joust borderline akt like ignorant and greedy children when it came to how the world actualy functioned, they had basicly bent backwards to accommodite the wishes/demands that "he" had for them to join the "Norse Empire of Nordiheim" and reclaim their "destiny" to becoume the new high nobles of the "new empire" as they expanded and eventualy "reclaimed" the lost lands of the old Empire of Scandica, apparently his family name Smør wasn't joust someting that they had in their arcives, it was extreemly well known to them, as apparently one of his ancestors had made a promis with them befoure going with the exodus furter south and him coming here to bring them into the fold was basicly honoring this promis, they had even shown them the binding scroll/contract that had needed new signatures to mark the promis as fulfilled wich allowed them to see that this claim was compleatly true and not a lie to trick them or expose their "Empire" deception, it was all incredibly lucky to be honest tough he doupted that his ancestors had made this deal with good intetions and had proberly planed for his family to use it in some way to screw these golden nobles and either bring them under their tottal rule or gain justification to crush them should they refuse, such had usualy been the way of nobles.

Becouse of this insanely fortunate coincident and the golden nobles blind greed, ignorance and desire to become high nobles of a great empire they had not only gotten everyting they had hoped for in the best case scenario, they had gained far more then they had tought posible in a time frame of two month instead of the almoust one year they had tought it could take at worst, they now controlled the majority of the commoners, the farmland used for food, rights of the sea for trade and commerce, most of the navy and its regular sailors, rulership of the overseas territories that the golden nobles had claimed or conquered on the continent to the north, the Golden Library that held the knowledge of the past that had been saved/preserved and most of the current info needed about the golden nobles and what they had been up to and also what was basicly a way to research and investigate the abilities of the Dragon warriors that had kept the golden nobles in power.
In return the golden nobles joust needed to keep the land they saw as the most valuable, the right to keep their dragon warriors as their privat armies and ofcourse the promise of rank and tittles as high ranking nobles only secound to who ever would eventualy be made the emperor of the empire when they reclaimed the old lands of Scandica and made what they had coined the "Intercontinental Norse Empire of Scandica and Argos!".

There was only 2 tings, or people, that realy seemed to pose a treath to Nordiheim council and their plans and that was Lord Otto of Falkenskiold and Lord Haakon of Tyrsblod.
Lord Haakon was among the 3 strongest of the golden nobles, if not the strongest, and showed far more inteligence and caution when it came to dealing with the "Norse Empire of Nordiheim" and its claims and promisses, tough the councils carefull planing and preparations seemed to have passed his inspection... for now, he also had made sure that any promis had been put into writhing as contracts and that the nobles retained the small part of the navy that contained the best and most powerfull ships, he also seemed against giving away as much as the other golden nobles wanted to do but he had ultimatly been overrulled by their much larger majority on most tings, he would proberly be the greatest treath as the plan moved forwards and so would have to be dealt with carefully.
The second persone was Lord Otto, the secound weakest of the golden nobles and so was always looking to increase his and his familys power and standing, ha was ofcourse a staunch suporter of the Tyrsblod family and as such Lord Haakon, he basicly joust agreed to anyting that Lord Haakon said and always suported anyting he laid forth, Knut did not like the vibes he felt from this almoust rat like person and he was proberly going to prove a problem in the future if they dident deal with him properly.

Other then these two tings Knut could not help but find this all hard to belive jet it all was true, he wondered what type of faces the council back in Nordiheim had been making as they got the reports of all this and also how they would react when they got the latest report of todays conclusion that had been sendt a few minutes ago, it would proberly take at minimum 3 weeks befoure the council would get all the reports befoure them and could send him new orders of how to proceed if they wanted changes to be made to the plan or if they should allready go to part two of the plan to deal with the golden nobles, in the meantime he would keep going with the orders that he had and that was to get people to go trough the information that was contained in the Golden Library, some shadow keepers would proberly be a good idea to have among these people, he also needed to make preparations to start the investigations into the abilities of the Dragon warriors so that they could find out their true numbers and strenght.

He also needed to figure out how to get Lord Morten of Gyldenhorn, the lord of the barony he had his base of opperation inn, deeper into his debt.
He had allready got him to becoume a close "ally" of the "Norse Empire of Nordiheim" by allowing him to take the glory of being the lord that initiated talks and negotiations with them aswell as providing him with some juicy deals and gifts to butter him up.
He needed to make sure that the lord did not want to do someting that could treathen the councils plan by making him to scared to look to deeply lest he loose his new found increase in wealth and power as was the weakest golden noble by far and so these two months had pretty much doubled his power to allow him to actualy start treathening Lord Otto of Falkenskiolds position as the second weakest golden noble, someting that was to their advantage.
It was almoust a pitty that Lord Morten would proberly be the first golden noble to fall when their plan would get to the last stage and he would proberly lose almoust everyting, but such was the way of tings, perhaps if he and his family could be persuaded to join them of their own free will they could keep some of their stuff, only time would tell.

A investigation into the overseas territories on the northern continent would also have to be done, joust how big were they, and who were the people?
He dident tink they would be ageinst joining them when the time came to bring the golden nobles down since they had been counqered by them, but what about afterwards?
Would they to join Nordiheim and becoume a proper part of their nation as a new region?
They would certanly be given the same rights and priviledges as the other regions, with their own councilor and all, but if they wanted to be free as their own nation they would undouptedly be  given that freedom as Nordiheim dident realy want to keep them ageinst their will as that would be expensive in both men and resourcess, if they could even keep them under their rule at all after dealing with the golden nobles as it wasn't known at this point how costly that would be to actualy achive.
The overseas territories was two enteties, the island of Olia and the land of North Ostland, Knut very much doupted that these were their original names, especialy 'North Ostland', perhaps the Golden Library would hold this information or perhaps he would get to travel the sea to another continent and see new lands and ask these peoples for their true name himself, it would make him the first of the Smør family to do so for several generations since the ancestor that had traveled in the great exodus.

He looked over at the "personal assistant" he had been assigned for his job as the defacto "Leader" of the "Norse Empire of Nordiheim", she was a decently looking lady that went by the name of Hilda Jansdottir and was fronted as coming from a long line of "assistants and officials" that had the "great priviledge" to serve the noble family of Smør.
Knut did not know how much of this was based on any type of truth and what was tottal fiction but he did know three tings for sure, one was that she were one of the shadow keepers and the other that she was scary good and playing her part in it all, so much so that he almoust forgot that she was a shadow keeper at times.
The third part was that she also was keeping an eye on him to make sure he didn't feel tempted to try and use this all as a opportunity to revive the Smør family as a great noble house and betray Nordiheim, he suposed that he felt some insult for not being trusted, but he had also been told by his father Canute of how bad the nobles could be, and it ofcourse also helped that he now had experienced them first hand with the golden nobles, tough he supposed that it wasent realy that bad as she had rather nice posterior and he could be rather charming if he wanted to.

[b][u]Required reading and meeting the Olia representative[/u][/b]

In december 961 AD Knut satt in his office in Hadanger going over some papers and reports as he waited for the representative of Olia island to soon arrive, while they were further away then North Ostland but was far more compliant, the people of North Ostland was apperently rather unruly and ressistant to do anyting more then the bare minimum they could get away with without invoking punitive action from the golden nobles and their Dragon warriors, not to supricing since they had been counqured, they even put up a decent fight apparently.

He had been sent a map of North Ostland by one of the people going over the tomes and scrolls of the Golden Library that had shown that it was a rather large territory, larger then they had asumed, and the people there dident seem fond of nobles either acording to some information he had managed to get out of Lord Morten that claimed that a whole army of five thousand dragon warriors was needed to keep them compliant (Knut had taken note of the number of dragon warriors that was considered a army, it aligned with what he had heard from some other sources as well).
But the more information they gained about these people the more baffling they became, apparently their old name had been 'Republiken af Nordland' (Republic of Nordland), this name seemed norse in origin as he could actualy understand it and it also seemed weird that the golden nobles seemed adamant that they held right of rule over them, unlike other nations along the southern coast of the northern continent, that he had found out was named Shamat or West Shamat as it apperently was split in two, that they did not realy seem interested in attacking but would rather trade with.
Were the people of North Ostland related to the Northlanders or some other group that had left the dying Empire of Nordica?
If they were related to the Northlanders there was the question of how they had ended up here, the few old texts that mentioned anyting about were they left the exodus seemed to place their chose land in south-western West Shamat, how did they end up so much further east?
Did someting perhaps happen to them, or did they split up for some reason and there was perhaps to groups of them now?
Questions without answers, perhaps the only way of figuring out the truth was to talk to them directly after gaining some trust with them, tough that would proberly take some time.

Knut was brouth out of his toughts as he heard a knock on his office door, it was the representative of Olia island that had arived, he greeted Knut with great politeness and introduced himself as Arashin from Olia and that he looked forward to his lordships great and benevolent rule.
Knut could see that the man most likely did not have a drop of norse blood in him, someting that was not unexpected as barely 10% of the people of the island of Olia had norse decent of any kind, the majorety was Shamatian of some kind, mostly West Shamatian if he remembered correctly.
He could also see that his eyes held someting that was either fear or anxiousness or maybe even both, proberly about what the future held for them, he had learned from some carefull conversations with Lord Morten that they had been "properly subjegated" to ensure they would learn to "appreciate" how they ruled when they were obedient to the golden nobles, most likely someting they did to make sure they didn't get another 'North Ostland' to deal with as that had ended up giving them little in return other then more expenses and land that needed to be garrisoned by a full army of Dragon Warriors as they couldent joust let them go either lest they take a hit to their presious prestige.

The Olia island representative was told to be honest about the state of his island and its people tough Knut had to be carefull to word it in the way a noble would do it as the Olian people would have to be considered likely to report suspicious behaviour to the golden nobles with how harshly they had been brought to heel by them.
While Knut had suspected that the Olian people had been mostly ignored after their subjegation from the few times he had managed to talk about it with some of the golden nobles it became quickly apparent from what Arashin told him that the nobles actualy hadn't done anyting on the island exept make a large port with a castle to extend their reach in trade and influence, ship in some unfortunate Ostland commoners to work there together with 500 Dragon Warriors to gard it all and ofcourse to implement a bunch of rules and laws that did noting but make life rather miserabel for the locals, such as making the trees of the island the property of the golden nobles and therefore illigal to chop down whitout permission from said nobles.
Because of this information it did not come as a big suprice when Arashin practicaly begged for his people to be granted permission to cut down trees for fishing boat construction so that they could fish for food as they had done for many generations, it seemed the land of Olia island was poorly suited for farming and the Dragon Warriors was rather heavy handed when upholding the laws and rules of their golden nobles usualy killing or maiming anyone who dared to break them, as such the Olians didn't dare to chop down a singel tree for fear of their brutal punishment.
But now it was 'Lord' Knut and the "Norse Empire of Nordiheim" that held the ownership over all the trees and Arashin seemed hopefull that he might gain the permision needed to chop down trees from them, Knut felt almoust bad for seing the great opportunety that this brought Nordiheim before anyting ells as this could make it much easier to creat a reason for the Olians to turn their loyalties towards them instead of the golden nobles, tough they would also need to convince them that they were able to handle the Dragon Warriors lest their fear of them might not only keep them from joining them but possibly fight for the golden nobles.

Knut gave the impression of tinking about what Arashin had asked permission for, even if the answer was obvious as far as Nordiheims plans was concerned, before telling the man that they would be given premission to chop down trees, he also told Arashim that a small team led by a minor 'noble' of his would come with him when he traveld back home to take propper stock of the island of Olia and its potential resources for future plans
With the right members this team would be able to learn more about the Olians and perhaps find some way to befriend the people that lived there.
After the first meeting with the Olian representative was concluded Knut waisted no time to get a message sendt to the Nordiheim council about this opportunity and urging them to get a team assembled to be sendt to Olia island to start the work needed to be done there.

The council had a team set up supricingly fast, as they had allready been pondering about how to approach the Olians and sending a team had been one of the ideas, as such they allready had a list of good candidates to chose from and had the team of their choice arrive at Hadanger all ready to go before even a month had gone by.
The 'lesser lord' that had been chosen to lead the team was sturdy Sorlandian fellow named Aegir Njordrson that came from a family line that had apparently been well known for their sailing tallents even back in the old Empire of Nordica, and in Nordiheim they used this tallent to make sure that lake Lifvatn and its rivers stayed clean of any ciminals or wanabee pirates that tried to make a living there, Aegir himself proved himself especialy tallented at comanding both ships and men and many felt that the great lake of Nordiheim simply was to small for someone like him, as such it was hoped that he woudn't joust be able to get in touch with the Olians but also use the time out in the ocean learn how it was different then a lake.
The man had been introduced as "Lord Aegir of Møre", as Møre was the name of a old noble family that had been known for their fleets and naval prowess, the mans imposing figure, eccentric personality and suprisingly great knowledge about sailing for someone that had never seen the sea before made it rather easy to convince people that he was of noble blood, the golden nobles that had come to meet this suposed Nordiheimian noble had proclaimed that "[i]Ofcourse someone of such great ability and stature is a noble, its the natural way of the world.[/i]"

After a 'neceseary' meeting that the golden nobels insisted on to be able to greet this Nordiheimian 'noble', that was more like their exuse to have a party and brag about themself tough Aegir semed to do a good jobb at stroking their egos joust enough that it seemed that they were finding him quite likeable, Knut would watch as the Olian ship together with two of their own ships sailed of into the horizion for their long voyage to Olia island, he could not help but feel a little anxious as it would take atleast several months before they would get their first report back about how the situation was out on the island and how Aegir was recived by the local Shamatans.

[b][u]Meeting the "North Ostlandians"[/u][/b]

Knut watched from his office window in the Hadanger castle as the two representatives, potentually Northlanders, from 'North Ostland' got of their ship escorted by two Dragon warriors, it had become apparent after the Olian ship had left together with the two ships with Aegirs team that the people in charge of 'North Ostland' were not intending to obey the summons they had gotten to come and talk with him, apparently they had gotten into the practice of ignoring the first time they got a summon or order by claiming that had "never recived" it or that the messager must have "given it to the wrong person".
Knut had asked some golden nobles why they had not put someone of their own people in charge since the 'North Ostlandians' was so disobedient and had gotten the answer that it had been tried but it had been even more of a headache as they would joust be constantly assasinated or be met with even more disruptive disobedience, so they had joust decided to lett the 'North Ostlandians' do the governing themself as they didn't realy care as long as they had their claims and tax was levied, the Dragon warriors would make sure they wouldn't break away anyway.

It was slightly anoying that they had to send a secound ship to 'convince' them that they needed to meet their new "Noble Lord" face to face, but it did provide them the oppurtunety to send shadow keepers hidden amongthis ships crew to act on some of the info they had found in the Golden Library to see if it might be true, unfortunatly even tough they originaly only wanted to send Nordiheimians on the ship it became apparent that some Dragon warriors had to come allong as Lord Morten, and a few of the other weaker golden nobles, had voiced the 'need' for some to come along and to keep watch over the representatives at all times when they were in the same room as a noble, Knut doupted that this was a atempt at sabotage and most likely was the weaker lords attempt to curry favor with him and the other Nordiheimian 'nobles' by showing how 'concerned' they were and lett them borrow some of their 'precious' Dragon warriors, they had ended up with about one hundred of them on the ship in the end so they were pretty safe atleast.

The one that had been sendt to deliver the new summons was Knuts "assistant" Hilda, the summons letter she delivered had been made using old Northerner code language and symbols and she herself was wearing a broche that had a Northern rune on it with a peticular meaning, to the golden nobles and their people it joust looked like fancy norse jewelery but to the northerners it actualy meant someting, "Truth hiden be a noble mask", it was hoped that they had retained enough of their of their Northern language and history for them to understand the code and symbol and that the information from the Golden Library was correct.

As the two 'North Ostlandians' and their escort entered the castle gate and left his view Knut looked over to the ship they had arived on and looked for Hilda, it had been agreed on that she would wear a dress in a spesific colour to signal how the potential Northerners reacted to the letter and runel on the her broche, red for a bad reaction, blue for no reaction and white for a good positive/confirmative reaction.
Knut let out a breath he hadn't noticed he was holding, she was wearing a dress that was clearly white, this ment that they were Northerners, or closely conected to them, and knew how to understand the code and the potential meaning of the rune and was positive to the possiblities they could hold, this was be the best case scenario for the councils plan.

He walked into the room he was going to meet the two Northerners inn and satt himself comfortably into his gilded chair that had a almoust throne like quality to it and composed himself, after a few minutes the two 'North Ostland' representatives entered the room with their Dragon warrior escort.
The first one was a old man that must have been atleast seventy years or older, he was somewhat on the short side with a long grey beard and light bronzen skin but of a solid build despite his old age and he was clearly of norse decent, he looked a bit like a dwarf from the old legends in a way.
The secound man was rather young in comparison, in his late twenties at most, while this young man had much less pronounced norse features they were still there, most likely the Northerners had mixed with the locals joust as much as they had, and while the features of his other decent looked rather similar to that of the Aboriginals of Argos they were still somewhat different, his skin was a dark brown colour and his black hair short and very curly, he seemed to be close to six feet tall and had a well trained and muscular build, he gave of the impresion of being trained as a warrior from a rather young age.

The young man introduced himself as Bheki Aghison and one of the three people allowed by the golden nobles to govern 'North Ostland' on their behalf, Knut could tell that this guy had a lot of contempt and hatred in his eyes as he stared at him, he was most likely not able to understand the code and rune 'shown' to the Northerners or he had not been told about it at all.
The elderly man on the other hand, who had introduced himself as Alfarr Gautison and adviser of Bheki, his eyes showed someting very different, while his body was held in a deffencive and guarded fasion it was easy for Knut to see that he had either seen the letter and rune or been told about them and understod their meaing in some way, he was obviusly studying him and trying to read who he trully was.

As they satt down and started to talk about the expected tings such as the delivery of future taxes, expectations and other tings that a person of nobility would talk about to his new subjects Knut would weave inn code Northern code words as he had been trained to by a shadow keeper that had studied them closly from the books in the Golden Library, this was ofcorse compleatly ignored or lost on the young Bheki and the Dragon warriors, who were mostly focused on keeping a eye on the young man as they saw him as the biggest treath of the two Northerners, but the old man on the other hand seemed to absolutely catch on to it.
It also became apparent trough the meeting that while Bheki had introduced himself as one of the people governing 'North Ostland' that it wasent he that was in charge of the two representatives, the elderly Alfarr would constantly reign inn the young mans intensity and fiery attetude with carefully chosen words and subtle jabs and pokes into the young Bheki that the Dragon warriors proberly couldent see from their position, but Knut could.
Perhaps the three people that had been chosen by the golden nobles to govern the 'North Ostland' territories was nothing more than obidient fronts that obeyed hiden leaders of the Northerners that the nobles would never approve off, perhaps these hiden people were made up off their old leaders even, unfortunatly Knut could not ask these questions to the two people infront of him with the Dragon warriors present.

As the talks came to a end Knut anounced that they would go to his office and sign the propper pappers as was normal for nobles, the golden nobles joust like the dethroned nobles of Nordiheim loved to have people sign pappers and documents that they could potentialy use ageinst them later as justification should they do anyting they dident like and to bolster their legitimacy so this was not a odd thing to do, and joust as it had been hinted at in the code that he had woven into their talks the old Alfarr spoke up and asked for permission to remain in the room and rest for a bit as his old body was not as sturdy as it ones had been, apologizing for the inconvenience.
Knut in his act as a noble offhandly gave him permission and commaned the two Dragon Warriors to follow him and Bheki who Knut could see in his eyes was slightly confused by Alfarrs words but did not outwardly show it say anyting about it, the Dragon warriors obidiently followed 'Lord' Knuts command as they remained focused on Bheki while almoust compleatly disregarding the old man as a treath.

After they had left the room the old Alfarr did not remain alone for long, out from a servants door that was more or less hiden from sight in a corner Hilda and another shadow keeper came out, the shadow keeper went to the main door of the room and stood guard while Hilda want to Alfarr.
She and Alfarr had a short and to the point conversation were the true nature of things were laid out as well as agreing to sett up a meeting between the a deligation from Nordiheim and group of people that the old man refered to as "The Elders", Hilda also gave him a coded document with a message for these elders that was made to look like a traditional Northern poem of good luck and protection, to someone who did not know how to read it propperly it would joust seem like a somewhat mediocer poem to the gods asking for safety to be given the recipient of the poem, in return she was given the poem that Alfarr had been given by his granddaughter and told Hilda that the Nordiheimian deligation had to have it with them as proof that they were friendly aswell as saying that they shouldent send any person of noble blood.
Hilda and the shadow keeper then left in silence leaving Alfarr alone again.

The old man placed the coded poem he had recived in the same place that his old one had been and waited for Knut and the others to return wich only took a couple of minutes.
When Knut and the others returned he could tell from the look the old man gave him that the secret meeting between him and the shadow keepers had been concluded and everyting had been settled for future talks with the Northerners and decided that the meeting with the 'North Ostlandian' representatives could be concluded, he bid them goodbye as he went to his thrown to "enjoy some wine" as the two men and their Dragon warrior escort was dismissed.
As Knut was left alone in the room idly wondered what had been agreed upon and decided he would try and ask Hilda later to see if she would be willing to tell him.

The two 'North Ostland' representatives would leave on their ship the next day after Alfarr had a "propper nights rest" to keep up his act of having been tired the day before, sailing off to the North back to West Shamat.
Knut watched their ship sail off from his office window having joust finished reading some documents from a golden noble that had "graciously" agreed to show off his grand Dragon warriors to him, he had managed to have a few words with Hilda who had told him some of the details about her secret meeting with the Alfarr and he was slightly disepointed that he would not get the chance to travel overseas this time with him being of noble blood and all that, he suposed that the Northerners had no real reason to harbor any love for nobles everyting considered and it would have been somewhat difficult to find a good reason for him to travel to their land anyway, perhaps he would simply need to wait until after the councils plan had been executed before he could travel to other continents, the golden nobles seemed to delight in finding ways to show off their power and wealth to him since he was seen as the highest ranking noble in their "empire".

He had also read in a report from some of the spies that they were slowly weaving into the different layers of Ostland society that the golden nobles had not been compleatly truthfull about the extent of their lands, most likely to avoid the land tax that was being implemented for them in accordance with the act of the "Norse Empire of Nordiheim" intentions of becoming the next Empire of Scandica, this was not unexpected but it did make it harder to propperly ascertain the extent of their power and wealth in its entierty wich could be bad for the councils longtearm plans.
They would have to find some way of to give the golden nobles some kind of encouragement to show off everyting they had that they simply counldn't resist, but what?
He wondered if the council would come up with someting or if they would have to search the Golden Library for some kind of solution that had been used in the past as he watched the north bound ship slowly disapear into the horizon.

Meanwhile the council of Nordiheim were about to get buisy with several problems and dealings that would have to be adressed and solved, as many new reports would be delivered to them over the next few months, aswell as aranging the orders to ensure that their grand plan for Ostland and its nobles progressed without incident.
Tough right now they only needed to deal with the small matter of the high priest of the Asatru religion having established a couple of religous villages on the other side of lake Lifvatn, apparently some devote explorers had found deposits of those magical glowing stones that they loved so much, naturaly they hadn't told them anyting about it as they had only found out about it from a local navy captain that had taken note of the many pilgrims that had sett sail across the lake from the Sorland region, much to the councils anoyance as the high priest did not have the permission to do nonsence like that without notifying them first.[/spoiler]

[quote=united_hydronia;59840781][b]THEP stance on the Technokratisches Kaiserreich[/b]
After much debate, the THEP council has come to the decision that action must be taken against the Technokratisches Kaiserreich (TK) in response to their unprovoked aggression against the Sikirskian people and their illegal occupation of the Nestor-Sikirsk territory. Sanctions are to be placed upon the TK by all THEP members and non-members are encouraged to follow. 

These sanctions include banning all trade with the TK, intercepting, searching and potentially seizing any and all ships bound to, or from the TK that enter a nations territorial waters, freezing all TK assets within a country and the banning of all travel to or from the TK (TK citizens within a nations borders at the time of this event will be allowed to safely return).
